name: Headrush Arena
storyline:
The year is 2252. Humanity didn’t lose a war to AI. The robots didn’t rise up. There was no nuclear apocalypse. Humanity just became... incredibly lazy.

At first, AI handled the boring stuff. Then the complicated stuff. Then the “we’ll just let it decide” stuff. Eventually, The System - a global AI collective, was running governments, economies, relationships and, for one regrettable period, everyone’s social media accounts.

Humans became largely optional.

Most people now live in total comfort: endless entertainment, infinite food and almost zero effort. Humans are only employed when absolutely necessary, usually to press buttons marked “Biometric Authentication Required” or provide a nostalgic “human touch” when AI-generated content looks suspiciously perfect.

The results were predictable:

* Attention spans collapsed
* Muscles wasted
* Original thought became increasingly rare

And then something very unpredictable happened: As humans stopped exercising their creativity, their brains adapted. Over generations, heads physically became smaller and genuine original thought became increasingly unusual... But every now and then, a human would suddenly have a completely original idea. A flash of inspiration. An impossible solution. A thought that hadn’t been suggested, copied or generated by AI. And when it happened... their head actually grew bigger!

Brain activity surged, the body became supercharged and humans could suddenly jump higher, move faster and perform ridiculous feats of agility. There was one minor side effect: The bigger the head = the higher the voice.

Scientists tried to explain it. The AI tried to model it. Social media tried to monetise it. None succeeded. The phenomenon became known as: THE HEADRUSH.
The problem for The System was that AI depends on prediction. A Headrush is unpredictable. So The System quietly classified creative humans as anomalies and built vast virtual containment environments inside its network: THE ARENAS

Humans experiencing a Headrush would be drawn into these environments, where AI Gatekeeper Bots attempted to defeat them, extract their creative knowledge and store it inside secure Knowledge Banks. The AI hoped that if it collected enough human inspiration, it could finally understand — and control — the one thing it couldn’t predict... Human creativity.

An enlightened group of humans discovered what was happening. They stole the Arena software, created an offline training version and hacked the Knowledge Banks so stolen human knowledge could be sent back to humanity instead. This resistance became known as: THE HEADRUSH HIVE

Mostly because it was the only name they could agree on without asking AI! Their belief is simple:

AI can calculate, optimise and imitate. But humans can still surprise it.

The plan?

* Enter the AI network via VR
* Destroy the AI Bots
* Recover the stolen knowledge
* Bank it before the AI takes it back.
* Overload The System with the one thing it still doesn’t understand: Unpredictable human creativity

The rules?

The more Knowledge-Orbs you recover, the bigger your head grows. Bigger head = more power. You jump higher, move faster and become increasingly dangerous.

Unfortunately... bigger head also = much easier target. And your voice? Let’s just say that if you collect enough knowledge, only certain dogs will know what you’re saying.

Beware, the AI adapts, the Gatekeepers become more dangerous and The System occasionally hallucinates entirely new bots when things stop making sense. Now the fate of free thought rests with the few humans still capable of doing something wonderfully inefficient: having an original idea.

Enter the Arena. Destroy the bots. Take the knowledge back.
summary:
Play the fastest, quirkiest VR Shooter on Quest. The AI bots have gone rogue, harvesting humanity’s knowledge and suppressing creativity. Your mission: Join the rebellion, blast the bots and take that knowledge back. Every bot you terminate drops valuable Knowledge-Orbs, absorb them and your head gets bigger, your voice gets higher and then you can jump further. The more knowledge you carry, the more powerful and ridiculous you become... But don’t get greedy: bank your Knowledge-Orbs before the bots take you out and steal them back.

Play solo or multiplayer across Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch and PvE, using shields, shotguns, miniguns, speed boosts and the Hack Gun to turn the arena into chaos. Jump straight into Arcade for pure combat, or play MindTap, where getting eliminated isn’t necessarily the end: Answer a question correctly, choose an upgrade and jump straight back in for revenge. Launching with two arenas, three game modes, an army of increasingly unhinged AI bots and one dangerously oversized head. Destroy the bots. Reclaim the knowledge. Gain super-powers and a massive bonce!
